## Answer sheet (open only after answering)

### 1. `CIVIO-D1022-SPCLR-0041`: key (C) Lopez and Reyes Bakery

- Why correct: "Lopez and Reyes Bakery" is filed first. Indexed order: LOPEZ / AND / REYES / BAKERY; LOPEZ / AND / RIVERA / LAW / OFFICE; LOPEZ / ANDRADA / CLINIC; LOPEZ / AUTO / SUPPLY. Read & as "and" and treat a leading "The" as the last unit (ARMA Rule 2). This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 2), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.
- (A) "Lopez Auto Supply" indexes as LOPEZ / AUTO / SUPPLY and files fourth, so it is not first. Picking it ignores this: the symbol & is indexed as the word "and".
- (B) "Lopez Andrada Clinic" indexes as LOPEZ / ANDRADA / CLINIC and files third, so it is not first. Picking it ignores this: compare unit by unit, letter by letter; nothing comes before something.
- (D) "Lopez & Rivera Law Office" indexes as LOPEZ / AND / RIVERA / LAW / OFFICE and files second, so it is not first. Picking it ignores this: the symbol & is indexed as the word "and".
- Source: Civio Filing Rules v2 / ANSI/ARMA 12-2005 <https://webstore.ansi.org/standards/arma/ansiarma122005>
- File: `docs/research/batches/drafts/subpro-clerical-2026-10-22.json`
